title: PROTEUS BCI Bordeaux — EEG/EMG Foundation Challenge 2026, Track 02
description: EEG recordings from 10 participants performing a brain-computer interface (BCI) protocol with three cued mental tasks: kinesthetic motor imagery of the non-dominant hand, mental subtraction, and word generation. Data were collected over 14 sessions (112 runs) in Bordeaux, including eyes-open and eyes-closed baselines, calibration runs with sham feedback, and online runs with real feedback using the Graz and BrainHero interfaces. The dataset is released as Track 02 of the EEG/EMG Foundation Challenge 2026.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel actiCAP slim / actiCHamp system (Brain Products); 41 channels are provided, sampled at 500 Hz, with mastoid M1 reference and FpZ ground, stored as EDF+. Each session comprised up to 8 runs: rest baselines (eyes open/closed), calibration runs with sham feedback, and online runs with real feedback. Cue onsets for the three mental tasks were recorded as OpenViBE event codes.
